cohort: The study participants were women registered to MomConnect in South Africa's KwaZulu-Natal, Free State, and Gauteng provinces.
finding: Factors such as returning to work/school and family influences were found to hinder exclusive breastfeeding intentions, despite helpful advice from the health system (including MomConnect) and varied understandings of EBF among participants.
mod_finding: Women who delivered by caesarean section were usually able to initiate breastfeeding a few hours after birth.
cross-section timing: Data was collected between February and March 2018.
